senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) = קוֹשִׁי, hardness, stiffness; difficulty. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ ed. Bub., supplement 14 אל תבט בק׳ ערפם look not at their stiffneckedness; Num. R. s. 16 end בקשה (corr. acc.).—Pl. קְשָׁיִין.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 305:1">Sifré Deut. 305</cite> <he>אין חבר נקנה אלא בקשי ק׳</he> a friend can be acquired only with the greatest difficulty.
